caption:
✍️ The comma splice

✅ Rule: A comma alone can't join two complete sentences.
❌ The bus was late, we missed the first class.
✅ The bus was late, so we missed the first class.
✅ Quick check: Fix it with a period, a semicolon, or comma + FANBOYS.
